stem.text: Two parallel metal plates are situated $20\,\text{cm}$ apart in a vacuum. They are connected to two sources of potential difference as shown.

stem.alt: Two horizontal parallel plates connected by wires to two sources, each with plus and minus terminals and earth symbols. The left source is labelled 800 V and the right source is labelled 300 V. A dot labelled proton is between the plates, and the plate separation is labelled 20 cm.

stem.text: A proton is released in the space between the plates.
What is the magnitude and direction of the acceleration of the proton?
